subject: MAP sync: evaluation milestones + security gating for AtlasPay POC
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@atlaspay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@atlaspay.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + security gating for POC (timeline proposal)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. Per our discussion, we'd like to formalize a short MAP that includes the security/compliance gates we need before productioning the POC. High level asks from AtlasPay: SOC 2 evidence for relevant control families, SIG/CAIQ answers for the hosted API, a DPA with data residency and retention language, and an inventory of logging/audit capabilities.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): agree MAP owners and acceptance criteria
- Week 1: Atlas sends SOC 2 control checklist + SIG questions we care about
- Week 2: Redwood provides SOC 2 scope summary + preliminary SIG responses
- Week 3: Exchange DPA redlines; confirm retention window and escrow options
- Week 4: Final acceptance run and go/no-go decision for POC production

Can you confirm owners on your side and whether this timeline is reasonable? We'll need a firm target close date — AtlasPay's steering committee meets 2025-07-01 so we'd like to be locked before then if possible.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Tran
Head of Integrations, AtlasPay

Attachment: sample MAP template (we'll accept XLSX)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@atlaspay.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + security gating for POC (timeline proposal)

Hi Sophie — thanks, this is a great starting point. Neha (security lead) and Ben (AM) are looped for ownership. Quick confirmations from our side:

- Owners: Neha will own SOC 2 evidence intake and SIG questionnaire; Ben will manage contract/DPA discussion and commercial milestones; I will own the MAP and runbook for closing acceptance.
- Target: we can aim for an internal acceptance window by 2025-06-26, which gives AtlasPay a week to present to your steering committee. Noted your 07/01 meeting.

I've attached a filled MAP_v1 with suggested owners and acceptance criteria, plus a one-page SOC2-scope-summary (early, not the full report). Two open items we should decide this week: data retention default (we propose 90 days for request payloads with option for 180/365 paid tier) and whether AtlasPay requires EU residency for any subset of data.

Next steps: Sophie — can your security ops send the SIG/CAIQ subset (or highlight which sections you need answers for) and confirm retention preference? We'll turn around answers in 5 business days.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20250612_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-scope-summary.pdf

From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@atlaspay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@atlaspay.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + security gating for POC (timeline proposal)

Thanks Rachel — quick clarifying notes from AtlasPay ops:
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll prioritize the SaaS data protection sections and the network controls (we'll send a cropped questionnaire by EOD Monday).
- Retention: 90 days default is acceptable for the POC; for production we want options up to 365 days for transaction metadata (we'll mark that as a commercial requirement).
- DPA: we'll propose minor redlines around subprocessor notification and an incident notification SLA (30 mins for incidents impacting PII).

I'll share the SIG crop and a short list of DPA redlines Monday. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Marco
Director, Platform Security, AtlasPay

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@atlaspay.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + security gating for POC (timeline proposal)

Hi Marco / Sophie — thanks for the clarifications. We're reviewing the SIG crop and will map each request to evidence sources. A few operational notes so expectations are aligned:

1) SOC 2 evidence: we can provide control narratives, recent SOC 2 Type II report excerpts for in-scope controls, and mapping to the POC architecture. Full report delivery requires an NDA addendum for distribution — flagging this so AtlasPay can confirm recipients.

2) Logging & audit: Redwood provides per-request trace IDs, tenant-level audit logs for admin actions, and clickstream retention (configurable). For the POC we can enable 180-day event retention in the staging project if you need extended visibility.

3) Data residency & export: if AtlasPay requires EU residency for a subset, we need to know which data class (e.g., raw request payloads vs. derived embeddings). Our private deployment offering supports region pinning; hosted API will require a dedicated VPC / dedicated capacity commitment.

4) Incident SLA: we can commit to a 30-minute notification for confirmed incidents impacting confidentiality of PII with a dedicated incident channel; remediation timelines depend on scope but we'll include RTO estimates in the DPA redline doc.

Action items for this week (from Redwood):
- Neha: draft SIG answers for the cropped sections (deliver by 2025-06-19)
- Ben: draft DPA with proposed incident SLA language and retention options (deliver by 2025-06-19)
- Rachel: update MAP workbook with accepted items and milestone owners (deliver by 2025-06-18)

I'll attach a short evidence checklist we typically use.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@atlaspay.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP sync: evaluation milestones + security gating for AtlasPay POC

Hi Sophie / Marco — quick status and proposed close cadence so AtlasPay can get to steering:

Status:
- SIG crop received; Redwood draft answers in progress (Neha).
- DPA: attached draft with proposed incident SLA (30 mins) and retention tiers (90/180/365). Please review the redline comments column.
- MAP workbook: Rachel updated owners and inserted a final acceptance checklist (PASS criteria for SOC 2 mapping + SIG queries + signed DPA).

Proposed close cadence:
- 2025-06-23: Redwood delivers SIG answers + updated DPA redline doc
- 2025-06-24: AtlasPay reviews and returns final redlines
- 2025-06-25: Executive approval & signoff window (internal at AtlasPay)
- 2025-06-26: Mutual acceptance and POC enablement

If those dates work for you, we'll lock the MAP and prepare the staging project. Two minor asks before we close: please confirm the list of people who will receive the SOC 2 extracts (so we can attach the limited-scope excerpts) and confirm whether you want the 180-day staging retention enabled for the POC.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA-proposed-redlines.docx, MAP_v1-final.xlsx
